assumptions: W7 of PLAN-0008, built in-session by a single writer. Same committed-self-contained model. A REVIEW-DRIVEN SECURITY FIX was applied and re-reviewed: the first independent review returned pass_with_notes but named an important finding - the committed git pre-push hooks and copied engine scripts were non-executable (mode 644), so git SILENTLY SKIPS a non-executable hook and following the documented `git config core.hooksPath hooks` left the local push gate INERT (an unproven push lands). Root cause: assemble_pack used shutil.copyfile (drops the exec bit) and the authored hooks were committed 644, SYSTEMICALLY across all 5 packs, and engine_drift ignored file mode so it went undetected (a `bash hook` test passes because it bypasses the exec-bit requirement; only the git-invoked path exposes it). Fixed comprehensively: assemble_pack now uses shutil.copy (copies mode), engine_drift is MODE-AWARE (a content-identical non-executable engine-script copy is reported as 'mode' drift), all committed pack git pre-push hooks + guard scripts + copied engine scripts are executable (100755), and the selftest asserts every pack's hook + warp-guard.sh is executable and that a stripped exec bit is caught as drift. This RETROACTIVELY corrected the already-shipped Cursor/Codex/Copilot/Antigravity packs (the fix commit flips 219 pack files 100644->100755 with byte-identical content). Two independent reviews: the first (pass_with_notes, named the finding, on a19806e); a scoped re-review bound to this commit 2e76cd0 (PASS, 0 blocking) that behaviorally proved via the REAL git-invoked path that the local push gate now fires (blocks unproven, allows proven) for opencode and cursor, the mode-drift teeth work, and the executable set matches canonical. The server-side CI required status check was always the unaffected backstop.

The commit also bundles the WARP-0806 review's plan reconciliation (PLAN-0008 pack-item depends_on for W3-W8 from WARP-0801 to WARP-0802, W2 correctly stays WARP-0801) - exactly six lines, plan validates. NOTE: plan_hash here (sha256:b86504755d842c46) is the CANONICAL hash via plan.py (parse_yamlish, capturing the work DAG); the earlier PLAN-0008 proofs (W2-W6) recorded a shallow front_matter-derived hash by a computation-method slip - harmless because plan_hash is informational and never re-checked by validate. A pre-existing latent note: specs/index.md embeds a 'Generated <date>' line, so a verify run on a later calendar day can go red on the first run and green on the second (a date-sensitivity of update_index.py, not a WARP-0807 defect).
